claim_scope: Stage-2 secondary-discovery fixed-eight mechanism falsification only; no engineering-baseline qualification, policy fit, generalization, confirmation, scale, test, or paper claim.
scientific_objective: Determine whether the task-wide legal structured-action contract makes high-quality Audio2Tool actions reachable by the frozen core, and separate that effect from executable knowledge delivered in the prompt.

population.name: A2T-NATIVE-STRUCTURED-ACTION-FIXED8
population.exposure: Identity-only SHA-256 selection from the already-exposed A2T-GROUND-QUAL-104 population after excluding G8, G8B, G8C, and CPV2 identities. This is secondary discovery, not an independent confirmation sample.

historical_parent.preseal_access_rule: Before both new strict manifests seal, verify only hashes and reconstruct source requests by exact identity. Do not read fixed-eight historical responses, per-sample scores, gold, or task text for analysis or selection.

REGISTRY_NO_SCHEMA.contact: sealed historical fixed-eight subset after both new manifests seal

HANDBOOK_NO_SCHEMA.contact: sealed historical fixed-eight subset after both new manifests seal

factorial.handbook_main_effect: task semantics delivered in the prompt

execution_protocol.only_scientific_request_factor: Add the identical response_format to each byte-identical historical parent request; request and accounting identity necessarily change.
execution_protocol.failure_rule: Seal all available traces, abort every open attempt, stop the service, and end without recontacting any row. Any recovery requires a prospective successor.

prompt_fit.measurement_rule: Reconstruct, serialize, measure, and hash the actual prompt, speech reserve, response schema, special-token reserve, and completion reserve immediately before every model contact. Never infer a later OpenJiuwen Loop envelope from this single-step screen.
prompt_fit.overflow_policy: Refuse before contact; never trim, truncate, lower a completion reserve, change the schema, or move a sample across slots.

required_before_gold: complete eight-row REGISTRY_STRICT_ACTION manifest and trace
complete eight-row HANDBOOK_STRICT_ACTION manifest and trace

postseal_scoring.official_scorer: unchanged a2t-toolcall scorer, single-process per complete manifest
postseal_scoring.score_invocation_limit: one effective invocation per complete fixed-eight cell manifest
postseal_scoring.historical_subset_rule: Materialize the two historical fixed-eight cell manifests only after both new cells and traces seal.
postseal_scoring.oracle: After all four scores exist, build and officially score one zero-contact per-row oracle using exact, then row slot F1, then tool correctness, then frozen cell order. This is a reachability ceiling, not a policy.

mechanism_gates.tie_rule: Prefer REGISTRY_STRICT_ACTION unless HANDBOOK_STRICT_ACTION has at least two paired exact wins and zero harms against it.

downstream_training_free_control.post_policy_target: Greater than 0.90 on a separately frozen held-out discovery or validation population, with paired gain over M0 and fixed AgentLoop and an attributable upstream-policy contribution.
downstream_training_free_control.scale_rule: Only after this screen passes and a separate OpenJiuwen AgentLoop experiment demonstrates information gain may an approximately-100-row VW experiment be preregistered. Approximately 1,000 rows remain closed until stable held-out gain.

terminal_rules.pass: Open only a separately preregistered OpenJiuwen AgentLoop integration on a different frozen discovery support roster.
terminal_rules.syntax_only: If schema fixes parsing or hard validity but misses reachability gates, record a syntax-only result and stop.
terminal_rules.failure: Keep AgentLoop policy fitting and VW closed. Expand task-wide canonicalization knowledge only when post-seal error analysis identifies a missing public representation that the current types, constraints, and compatibility forms cannot express.

prohibitions: This preregistration does not authorize model, service, scorer, tokenizer, network, gold, reference-transcript, historical fixed-eight output, score, reward, test, or future-turn contact.
Do not repair, retry, resend, normalize, synthesize, or replace a frozen-core final response.
Do not fit any policy or local learner on this fixed-eight screen.
Do not expand to approximately 100 or 1,000 rows without the separately frozen promotion sequence.
